summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the new API Key Usage Analytics feature. All backend tests passed (16/16 pytest). All frontend tests passed. The feature correctly tracks API key usage including request counts, success/failure rates, token usage, cost tracking, model breakdown, and response time trends.
critical_code_review_comments: API Key Analytics overview endpoint correctly returns list of keys with analytics (total_requests, successful, failed, tokens, avg_duration_ms)
API Key Analytics detail endpoint returns comprehensive data: summary, requests_by_day, model_breakdown, platform_breakdown, error_breakdown, cost_by_model, recent_requests
Authentication and X-Instance-ID header correctly enforced on both endpoints (401/400 without them)
Frontend page has proper data-testid attributes: api-key-analytics-page, key-card-{id}, days-filter, refresh-analytics
Sidebar correctly shows 'API Key Usage' with Activity icon between 'API Integrations' and 'Embed Code'
seed_data_creation: No test data created - used existing API key with label 'mainnet_user_3f0bc1c3dda8f3d8' which has 3 requests of usage data
